title: This 'adversarial' pattern can prevent surveillance cameras from detecting you | TechCrunch
summary: Swearingen’s computer-generated patterns do not block surveillance cameras from recording video footage. His models are continuing to grind out new patterns. “Every failure improves my model, and so [the patterns] keep getting better and better,” he said.
